methodology: Candidate is ESPN's absolute bottom final finisher only when the latest LOSERS_CONSOLATION_LADDER matchup pairs final positions 13 and 14 and position 14 loses. Regular-season seed/standing is reported for context but never selects the punishment loser.

notes: Placement-ladder structure: the bottom finisher won an earlier consolation matchup before losing the final punishment matchup.
